from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(length, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for cut in cuts+[length]:
            if start < cut: out.append((start,cut))
            start=cut+1
        return out
    row_spans=spans(h,sep_rows); col_spans=spans(w,sep_cols)
    sep_values={grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    colors={x for row in grid for x in row}
    base_color=max((x for x in colors if x not in sep_values), key=lambda x: sum(v==x for row in grid for v in row))
    markers=colors-sep_values-{base_color}
    marker=next(iter(markers))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))==2 else 5
             for c0,c1 in col_spans] for r0,r1 in row_spans]
'''
path=base/'task-9eacc57a.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path.read_text())
